Name: Arduino UNO R4 WiFi
Description: Connect sensors, control outputs, and send your prototype’s data over WiFi.
Notes: Board with built-in WiFi, Bluetooth hardware, and a 12 × 8 LED matrix. Start with the UNO R4 WiFi setup guide and select this exact board in the Arduino IDE.

Name: Ultrasonic distance sensor
Description: Measure distance for parking, proximity, or model water-level experiments.
Notes: RCWL-1601, compatible with HC-SR04 timing. Keep the electronics dry; this is an exposed benchtop sensor.
Keywords: distance parking water level sonar HC-SR04 RCWL-1601

Name: Anti-static shielding bags
Description: Protect small components while moving or storing your prototype.
Notes: SCS 30033 zip-top shielding bags, 3 × 3 inches. Keep unpowered loose electronics inside.

Name: Photoresistor
Description: Sense relative light levels for lighting and daylight-responsive prototypes.
Notes: Combine with a fixed resistor to form a voltage divider. Read the divider with an analog input; resistance changes with light.

Name: Piezo buzzer
Description: Add an audible alert to a crossing, threshold, or status demonstration.
Notes: Soberton PT-1303T is an externally driven piezo element. It needs an alternating signal such as Arduino tone(), rather than steady DC.

Name: Yellow LED · 5 mm
Description: Show caution states and build miniature traffic signals.
Notes: Marktech MT3118-Y-A, diffused through-hole LED. Use a current-limiting resistor and observe polarity.

Name: Green LED · 5 mm
Description: Show normal operation, a successful action, or a green traffic signal.
Notes: Marktech MT2118-G-A, diffused through-hole LED. Use a current-limiting resistor and observe polarity.

Name: Red LED · 5 mm
Description: Show stop states, warnings, or thresholds in your prototype.
Notes: Marktech MT4118-HR-A, diffused through-hole LED. Use a current-limiting resistor and observe polarity.

Name: USB-C to USB-C cable
Description: Power and program your Arduino from a USB-C computer.
Notes: CviLux DH-20UE0062-NH, 150 mm cable with USB-C male connectors at both ends. Supports data transfer as well as charging.

Name: Resistor assortment
Description: Build voltage dividers, limit LED current, and bias transistor circuits.
Notes: SparkFun COM-10969 assortment. Each kit contains 500 resistors across common values. Read the color bands before selecting a value.

Name: 400-point solderless breadboard
Description: Wire and revise circuits quickly without soldering.
Notes: DFRobot FIT0096 with 400 tie points and removable power rails. Use a continuity check if you are unsure which holes connect.

Name: 6-axis accelerometer + gyroscope
Description: Measure movement, tilt, and rotation for mobility and infrastructure models.
Notes: Adafruit LSM6DS3TR-C breakout. Supports ordinary soldered headers as well as STEMMA QT; a Qwiic controller is not required. It has no magnetometer.
Keywords: IMU motion vibration acceleration orientation gyro six axis

Name: Standard positional servo
Description: Move a model gate, barrier, shade, or other small mechanism.
Notes: FEETECH FS5103B from Pololu. Use an appropriate external motor supply with common ground to the Arduino; a Motor Shield is not required for its control signal.
Keywords: motor rotation position gate barrier PWM

Name: Arduino Motor Shield
Description: Control DC motors or stepper motors in a moving prototype.
Notes: Adafruit product 1438, listed as v2 in the purchase order. Supports four DC motors or two steppers. Check the supplied board revision and library support for your Arduino.
Keywords: motor driver H bridge stepper shield

Name: Temperature & humidity sensor
Description: Measure ambient conditions for comfort, weather, and environment projects.
Notes: Adafruit AHT20 breakout. Connect with headers or STEMMA QT. Default I2C address is 0x38.
Keywords: AHT20 temperature humidity weather climate comfort

Name: VOC air-quality sensor
Description: Track changes in indoor air quality using a relative VOC index.
Notes: Adafruit SGP40 breakout. Use the VOC Index algorithm and temperature/humidity compensation. This sensor does not measure CO2 or particulate matter.
Keywords: SGP40 air quality volatile organic compounds VOC indoor ventilation

Name: Mini vibration motor
Description: Create tactile alerts for wearable or accessible city prototypes.
Notes: Adafruit 1201 disc motor. Drive through a PN2222 transistor with a base resistor and a flyback diode; do not drive it directly from an Arduino GPIO.

Name: PN2222 NPN transistor
Description: Switch a small motor or other load using a microcontroller signal.
Notes: onsemi PN2222ABU, TO-92 package. Use a base resistor. Check the exact datasheet pinout and the load current before wiring.
Keywords: PN2222 PN2222A NPN BJT switch motor driver

Name: 1N4007 flyback diode
Description: Protect a switching transistor from a motor’s inductive voltage spike.
Notes: Diotec 1N4007. For a flyback connection, place it across the motor with the striped cathode toward the positive supply.

Name: 0.91-inch OLED display
Description: Display live sensor readings, messages, and simple graphics.
Notes: Adafruit 4440, monochrome 128 × 32 display. Supports headers or STEMMA QT; default I2C address is 0x3C.

Name: 9 V battery holder
Description: Mount a 9 V battery and connect it to a suitable power input.
Notes: MPD BH9VW with 6-inch leads. Holder only; battery is not included. Do not connect 9 V directly to a 5 V pin.

Name: 2 × AA battery holder
Description: Create a compact battery supply for low-voltage circuits.
Notes: Keystone 2463, two cells in series with 6-inch leads. Holder only; batteries are not included. Two alkaline cells provide about 3 V nominal.

Name: 4 × AA battery holder
Description: Build a battery supply for compatible motors and prototypes.
Notes: MPD BH4AAW, four cells in series with 6-inch leads. Holder only; batteries are not included. Four alkaline cells provide about 6 V nominal.

Name: GPS / GNSS breakout
Description: Log outdoor position and time for mobility and tracking projects.
Notes: Adafruit Ultimate GPS PA1616D with GPS + GLONASS reception. Start outdoors with a clear view of the sky; a first position fix can take time.
Keywords: GNSS GPS location outdoor mobility tracking positioning GLONASS

Name: Turbine water-flow sensor
Description: Count water flow for a benchtop plumbing or leak-detection model.
Notes: Adafruit 5066 clear turbine sensor with 3-pin JST. Designed for about 1–30 L/min. Calibrate with a measured volume; it is not a pressure sensor.
Keywords: water liquid flow plumbing leak turbine

Name: PIR motion sensor
Description: Detect movement for occupancy-triggered lighting and activity demos.
Notes: Adafruit 189 passive infrared sensor with adjustable sensitivity and timing. Allow it to settle after power-up. Detects changes in infrared radiation, rather than reliably counting people.
Keywords: PIR infrared occupancy presence motion people

Name: Particulate air-quality sensor
Description: Measure airborne PM1.0, PM2.5, and PM10 for air-quality projects.
Notes: Adafruit PMSA003I breakout with fan and optical particle sensing. Keep the inlet and outlet unobstructed. Default I2C address is 0x12.
Keywords: PMSA003I particle particulate PM2.5 PM10 pollution air quality

Name: Illuminated arcade button
Description: Give your prototype a large, easy-to-press user control.
Notes: Adafruit 3491 translucent clear button for a 30 mm panel hole. Switch and illumination use separate terminals. Use the quick-connect harness for the switch leads.
Keywords: button switch pushbutton arcade input accessibility

Name: Arcade button wire pairs
Description: Connect arcade button terminals without soldering directly to the switch.
Notes: Adafruit 1152 pack contains ten wire pairs with 0.11-inch connectors. One pair connects a button’s two switch contacts; illumination needs additional leads.
Keywords: harness wires arcade quick connect cable
